classified_spans.text:
Here is my audit report with the top 8 actionable improvements, each suitable as a standalone PR:

---

**1. SearchButton.svelte: MutationObserver and popstate listener are never cleaned up (memory leak)**

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\buttons\SearchButton.svelte`, lines 38-45

The component creates a `MutationObserver` on `document.body` (line 38-42) and adds a `window.addEventListener("popstate", ...)` (line 44), but neither is ever disconnected/removed. There is no `onDestroy` lifecycle call. Since SvelteKit navigations can mount and unmount this component, every navigation that remounts it adds another observer and listener that never gets cleaned up.

Fix: Wrap the setup in `onMount` and add `onDestroy` to call `observer.disconnect()` and `window.removeEventListener("popstate", updateSearchState)`.

Also note this file still uses the legacy `on:click` syntax (line 48), which contradicts the stated migration to `onclick` that was done elsewhere.

---

**2. Cards.svelte: keydown listener added but never removed (memory leak)**

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\layout\Cards.svelte`, lines 34-40

The `onMount` callback adds `window.addEventListener("keydown", keypressInput)` (line 37) but there is no corresponding `onDestroy` to remove it. Both `Lab.svelte` and `TalkMozilla.svelte` properly pair their `addEventListener` with `removeEventListener` in `onDestroy`, but `Cards.svelte` does not.

Fix: Add `onDestroy(() => { window.removeEventListener("keydown", keypressInput); })`.

---

**3. TalkMozilla.svelte: Three `any` typed state variables; missing TypeScript on event handler**

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkMozilla.svelte`, lines 23-30, 45

- `canvas` (line 23) should be typed as `HTMLCanvasElement | undefined`
- `pdfDoc` (line 25) should be typed using `PDFDocumentProxy` from pdfjs-dist (which is already imported)
- `pages` (line 30) should be typed as `HTMLCanvasElement[]`
- The `keypressInput` function (line 45) has no type annotation on its `e` parameter -- it should be `KeyboardEvent`

These are all straightforward type improvements in a single file.

---

**4. Podcast.svelte: `hideSummary` prop is accepted but not declared in the Props interface**

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Podcast.svelte`, line 7

```typescript
interface Props {
  lo: Podcast;
}
let { lo, hideSummary = false }: Props = $props();
```

The `hideSummary` prop is destructured and used (line 28) but is not declared in the `Props` interface. This means TypeScript does not validate callers -- it should be `hideSummary?: boolean` in the interface. The component at `Wall.svelte` line 28 passes `hideSummary={true}`, so this is actively used.

---

**5. Unsanitized HTML injection via `{@html}` across 14 locations -- no DOMPurify or sanitization**

Files (all `{@html}` usage sites):
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\llm\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, lines 30-31
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\search\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, line 98
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Lab.svelte`, lines 67, 76, 85
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Note.svelte`, line 22
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Video.svelte`, line 60
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Podcast.svelte`, line 30
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\layout\Card.svelte`, line 104
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\structure\LoReference.svelte`, line 30
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\buttons\InfoButton.svelte`, line 19
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\footers\TutorsMessage.svelte`, line 18
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(auth)\auth\TutorsTerms.svelte`, line 29

The `convertMdToHtml` function in the model library (line 29 of `markdown-utils.ts`) has `html: true` enabled in its MarkdownIt config, which means raw HTML in markdown source passes through unescaped. Course content is fetched from external URLs (course repos), so a malicious course author could inject arbitrary scripts. There is zero DOMPurify or sanitization anywhere in the codebase (confirmed by grep).

Fix: Add DOMPurify as a dependency and sanitize the output of `convertMdToHtml` before rendering with `{@html}`, or create a wrapper component `<SafeHtml html={...} />` that sanitizes centrally.

---

**6. Invalid HTML element `<prose>` used in InfoButton.svelte**

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\buttons\InfoButton.svelte`, line 18

```html
<prose class="prose dark:prose-invert">
  {@html currentCourse?.value?.contentHtml}
</prose>
```

`<prose>` is not a valid HTML element. Browsers will treat it as an unknown inline element, which can cause layout issues and fails HTML validation. It should be a `<div>` (as done everywhere else in the codebase where `class="prose"` is applied to a `<div>` or `<article>`).

---

**7. Multiple `data: any` typed page props that can be properly typed with PageData**

Files and lines:
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\catalogue\+page.svelte`, line 7: `data: any`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(auth)\auth\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, line 5: `data: any`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\course\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, line 5: `data: any`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\llm\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, line 8: `data: any`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\time\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, line 10: `data: any`

SvelteKit auto-generates `PageData` types for each route based on the `+page.ts`/`+page.server.ts` load function. The search page (`D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\search\[courseid]\+page.svelte`, line 8) already demonstrates the correct pattern: `import type { PageData } from "./$types"` and using that as the prop type. All the other pages listed above use `data: any` instead, losing all type safety on the data returned from load functions.

---

**8. Service type interfaces use `any` where concrete types exist**

Files and lines:
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\types.ts`, line 57: `currentTheme: any` -- should be `{ value: string }` (it holds a theme name string in a reactive wrapper, consistent with `layout` and `cardStyle` on lines 58-59)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\types.ts`, line 59: `lightMode: any` -- should be `{ value: boolean }` or `{ value: string }` depending on usage
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\types.ts`, line 45: `courseUrl: any` -- should be `{ value: string }` (same reactive wrapper pattern)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\types.ts`, line 54: `intervalId: any` -- should be `ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null` (confirmed by usage at `connect.svelte.ts` lines 199-213)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\types.svelte.ts`, line 147: `updateLogin(courseId: string, session: any)` -- `session` is a Supabase/Auth.js session; only `session.user` is accessed (line 81 of `analytics.svelte.ts`), so this can be typed with the Auth.js `Session` type
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\types.svelte.ts`, line 154: `course_record: any` in `CatalogueEntry` -- the actual shape is known from the Supabase table
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\markdown\types.ts`, line 8: `codeThemes: any` -- should match the Shiki bundled themes type or at minimum `Record<string, unknown>`

These are all in type definition files and can each be tightened without any runtime changes. They could reasonably be combined into a single "tighten service interface types" PR.
